title: Republic Act No. 12059
text:
H. No. 9593

Republic of the Philippines
Congress of the Philippines
Metro Manila
Nineteenth Congress

Chirk Regular Seastan

Begun and held in Metro Manila, on Monday, the twenty-second
day of July, two thousand twenty-four.

[ REPUBLIC AcT No. 12059]

AN ACT SEPARATING THE LAPUYAN NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL
~ PAMPANG EXTENSION IN BARANGAY PAMPANG,
MUNICIPALITY OF LAPUYAN, PROVINCE OF
ZAMBOANGA DEL SUR FROM THE LAPUYAN NATIONAL
HIGH SCHOOL, CONVERTING IT INTO AN INDEPENDENT
NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL TO BE KNOWN AS THE
PAMPANG NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL, AND
APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR

Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the Philippines in
Congress assembled:

SECTION 1. The Lapuyan National High School — Pampang
Extension in Barangay Pampang, Municipality of Lapuyan,
Province of Zamboanga del Sur is hereby separated from the
Lapuyan National High School and converted into an
independent national high school to be known as the Pampang
National High School.

 
 
SEC. 2. All personnel, assets, liabilities, and records of
the Lapuyan National High School — Pampang Extension are
hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Pampang
National High School.

SEC. 3.The Secretary of Education shall immediately
include in the Department’s program the operationalization of
the Pampang National High School, the initial funding of which
shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation
of the Lapuyan National High School — Pampang Extension.
Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued
operation of the school shall be included in the annual
General Appropriations Act.

Sec. 4.Within ninety (90) days from the approval of
this Act, the Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules
and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act.
Such implementing rules and regulations shall provide for the
school’s organization, administration, operations and
management, in accordance with Republic Act No, 9155, or the
“Governance of Basic Education Act of 2001”, Republic Act
No. 10533, or the “Enhanced Basic Education Act of 2018”,
and other basic education-related laws.

Suc. 5. This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its
publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of
general circulation.

Approved,
FRANCIS “CHIZ” G. ESCUDERO IN, G.RONMUALDEZ
President of the Senate Speaker of the House

of Representatives

This Act, which originated in the House of Representatives,
was passed by the House of Representatives and the Senate of the
Philippines on December 12, 2023 and August 28, 2024, respectively.

REGINALD S.“VELASCO

Secretary General
